note: PLAN §3.5. Source of truth for the recording sheet, the Gemini TTS script, and the assembled track. `start`/`end` are seconds on the 120s film timeline. Silence between entries is deliberate — roughly a third of the film carries no narration, and the approval click at 1:34 plus the MCP proof at 1:37–1:47 play almost dry.

pace.why: Charon reads at ~120 wpm. Copy is sized against that, measured, not against the 135 a human would hit.

lines.text: Every tool sees a sliver of your work. So your attention goes to re-explaining what already exists.
lines.direction: state this as a relaxed observation, not a complaint — no sympathy or heaviness in the voice

lines.text: Information is abundant. Learning is fragmented.
lines.direction: two separate statements of fact, even and unhurried, with no lift on either

lines.text: One workspace. One memory. Continuum opens on your next step, and why.
lines.direction: assured and clear, with a small warm lift on the last few words

lines.text: It finds the best resource, and shows you why it won. It maps what you know, tests it, and adapts when you get something wrong. Mastery is earned, not assumed.
lines.direction: bright and engaged, leaning very lightly on "why" and "adapts"

lines.text: Outcomes become a week of work, with proof.
This is the live scholarly graph — real papers, real citations. Follow the evidence, keep what matters, and it lands beside your Zotero library, every PDF indexed and searchable.
lines.direction: easy and unfussy, letting each clause land without weight

lines.text: Every claim, tied to its source.
Your notes don't have to move. Continuum meets them in Obsidian — plain markdown.
lines.direction: friendly and reassuring, as if casually removing an objection

lines.text: Everything becomes memory — retrieved by relevance, not replay.
lines.direction: clean and certain, leaning very lightly on "relevance"

lines.text: Run it. When it breaks, the fix cites the paper you just saved.
lines.direction: easy and slightly wry, as if it were unremarkable

lines.text: It connects to what you already use —
lines.direction: light and easy, with a small forward lift at the end

lines.text: — so the assistant already knows your mastery, your weak spots, your deadline. It proposes. You approve.
lines.direction: even and warm, landing the last two sentences cleanly and lightly

lines.text: And because Continuum speaks MCP, that memory follows you into Claude itself.
lines.direction: relaxed and confident — understated, as if it were obvious
three separate words, each landing on its own — flat, certain, no rise

lines.text: Information is abundant. Learning is fragmented. Continuum is one workspace — where knowledge compounds.
lines.direction: warm and assured, clean and even — confident rather than solemn

ttsNote: Two things Gemini TTS takes literally, both learned the hard way: asking for a pause or beat inserts multi-second silences (line 10 once returned 32.4s for 14 words), and emotional words like "weariness" or "finality" produce a genuinely mournful read. Directions carry register and emphasis only. `houseStyle` is prepended to every line so all ten sound like one performance.
houseStyle: In the voice of a premium technology brand film — calm, warm and assured, at an easy natural pace. Confident and matter-of-fact. Light rather than heavy, never sad, never dramatic, never salesy
bookend: Line 2 and line 11 both say "Information is abundant. Learning is fragmented." That is deliberate: line 2 lands it as the problem, on the frame where the hook puts the same words on screen; line 11 repeats it and resolves it. Do not de-duplicate them.
coverage: Narration now covers ~80% of the runtime. Two silences are deliberate and must survive any future edit: Review at 1:33–1:37 (the approval click lands in the clear) and 1:47–1:49 after "Twice." Everything else was dead air — Plan, Research and Code carried no narration at all, which on a film judges score from is a wasted feature explanation.
